import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    arr.sort()
    itv = int(next(it))
    ans = 0
    for i in range(n):
        cnt = 0
        for j in range(i, n):
            if arr[j] <= itv + arr[i]:
                cnt += 1
        ans = max(ans, cnt)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
